categories.main_business_segments: Maider Medical Industry Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment for medical consumables. Its main product lines include safety infusion devices and blood purification devices, with additional development in drug-device combination products and clinical testing consumables. The company also operates in the manufacturing of automated assembly lines for various medical consumables such as infusion sets, needles, syringes, dialysis equipment, and related components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed multiple proprietary core technologies including high-speed multi-channel automatic feeding, medical soft catheter shaping, secondary plastic forming, curved surface solvent bonding, soft sticky medical consumables assembly, dialysis device packaging and assembly, and GMP data management platforms. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as modular design, system integration, automated assembly, and real-time high-precision visual inspection. The production model combines order-based manufacturing with moderate pre-production, emphasizing customization to meet specific client needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Maider Medical serves leading medical consumable manufacturers including well-known domestic and international clients such as Weigao Group, Contec Medical, Sanxin Medical, and Fresenius Kabi. Its products cater to manufacturers of high-value medical consumables like infusion devices, blood purification consumables, insulin pens, and prefilled syringes. The company’s equipment supports production for hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and medical device manufacturers, targeting both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, and has subsidiaries in Tianjin, Shanghai, and Germany. Its sales cover domestic markets extensively and also include exports to overseas regions. The overseas business is expanding but still represents a smaller portion of total revenue. The company actively promotes market penetration in Europe, the Americas, and developing countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Maider Medical operates upstream and midstream in the medical consumables supply chain by providing intelligent manufacturing equipment and automation solutions to medical consumable producers. It focuses on supplying customized automated assembly lines and production equipment that enable downstream manufacturers to produce high-quality medical consumables efficiently. The company also plans to extend downstream by supplying certain core consumable components to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development with significant investment in R&D, accounting for 14.7% of revenue in 2024. It focuses on advancing intelligent manufacturing technologies, expanding product categories especially in drug-device combination products, and developing digital factory solutions. R&D efforts include new product development, process optimization, and intellectual property protection. The company also invests in expanding production capacity and enhancing overseas market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment for medical consumables. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model, engaging closely with customers to tailor equipment solutions. Additional revenue streams include software development services and after-sales maintenance. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but these are ancillary to its core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Maider Medical is a leading domestic player in the intelligent equipment manufacturing sector for medical consumables, recognized as a pioneer with multiple national and provincial awards for first-of-its-kind products. It holds a dominant market share in China, especially in safety infusion and blood purification equipment. The company faces competition from both domestic and international manufacturers but maintains a competitive edge through advanced technology, comprehensive product lines, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 274.85 million, a 42.77% decrease from 2023, primarily due to market demand fluctuations and increased competition. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 19.98 million, reflecting a 120.02% decline. Total assets stood at RMB 1.05 billion with net assets of RMB 810 million. Despite short-term declines, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for long-term growth and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Maider Medical emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product quality, and customization capabilities as key differentiators. Its intelligent equipment improves production efficiency, product quality, and compliance with stringent medical standards. The company offers comprehensive solutions including hardware, software, and process optimization, fostering strong customer loyalty. Its products have achieved multiple national firsts and certifications, supporting domestic substitution of imported equipment and addressing complex manufacturing challenges in medical consumables.
